user.title: WiFi Presence
user.description: Scans your WiFi network and listens for Bluetooth to see which devices are around. Google WiFi uses 192.168.86.0/24 by default.

menu_options.name: Name a device (to tell devices apart)
menu_options.link: Add Bluetooth or other signals to a device

settings.title: WiFi Presence devices
settings.description: Pick the devices to track. WiFi devices and Bluetooth devices are both listed, with the names you gave them. A device that only shows up over Bluetooth works fine on its own. To use WiFi and Bluetooth together for one device, track its WiFi entry, save, then use 'Add Bluetooth or other signals to a device'. Can't tell which is which? Use 'Name a device' from the menu. Don't see one? Wait a minute and reopen this, or add it by address below.

data.manual_macs: Add WiFi device by MAC (optional, comma separated)
data.manual_bluetooth: Add Bluetooth device by address (optional, comma separated)

name.title: Name a device
name.description:
Pick a device to give it your own name. Devices without a name of yours are listed first.

Tips for telling them apart:
- Bluetooth: hold the device right next to your Bluetooth adapter or proxy. The strongest signal (closest to 0 dBm) is usually it. The maker in brackets helps too.
- WiFi: 'random MAC' means a phone or tablet using a private address. Check the IP in your router's device list, or turn the device's WiFi off and on and reopen this to see which one changed.

name_details.title: Name this device
name_details.description:
{device}

Type a name like 'Kitchen tablet' or 'Mom's watch'. It becomes the tracker's name and shows in every list. Leave it empty to clear the name.

link.title: Pick a device
link.description: Choose the tracked device you want to add Bluetooth or other signals to.

link_details.title: Extra signals
link_details.description:
{device}

The device counts as home if ANY signal sees it. Leave a box empty to skip it.

data.bluetooth: Bluetooth device (pick one, or type an address)
data.irk: Bluetooth IRK (for phones that rotate their address)
data.entities: Other trackers or sensors (like the Companion app tracker)

remove.title: Remove devices
remove.description: Tick the devices you don't use. They stop being tracked and their tracker entities are deleted from Home Assistant. A device that is still on your network can be added again later from 'Devices and scan settings'.
